author: GamingBolt
description:
Talion might not have been a name we would bother with if not for the gruesome fate he suffers at the beginning of his adventure in Mordor, and the consequences that ensue. Being banished from death sounds like serious business, and it is, but that doesn’t mean that there isn’t some room to have a little fun along the way, is there?

Well, the Middle-Earth: Shadow franchise answers that question with a resounding yes, and we’re here to remind you of how it does in our review of the Switch 2 version. If you’re thinking about building an Orc army on the go, we’ve got many things to tell you about why it’s a very good idea, as long as you’re willing to sacrifice a bit of your social life to achieve it.
title: Middle-Earth Shadow of Mordor And Shadow of War Switch 2 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day is getting quite close, and we can’t wait to see how it all pans out. This one’s got a lot to live up to, while also needing to carve out its own corner of the franchise’s history in the process. It’s aiming for a specific kind of experience to fulfill that goal, but can it manage to nail things down well enough?

We’re here to take a look at what it has going for it, and where it could stand to mitigate a few risks. If you’re a seasoned COG veteran itching for another go at your age-old enemies, or a new recruit looking to get your hands dirty, this one’s for you.
title: Can Gears of War E-Day Bring Back The Magic of the Original Trilogy?

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 Remastered has given us a great reason to visit a world that’s going to take several hours of our time over the next few months. But it’s now not the only big player in a genre that has seen a new entrant shake off a dubious debut to become a legitimate challenger to the crown that Geralt wears with pride.

Crimson Desert Enhanced marks an evolution that’s as thorough as it is meteoric. We must examine how it has changed Pywel for the better against the backdrop of what Remastered is bringing to the table. This one’s a battle between two heavyweights, so grab your popcorn and settle in for an exciting match-up.
title: The Witcher 3: Remastered vs Crimson Desert Enhanced - Which One Did It Better?
